title: Clarity reveals a principle’s meaning

captions.physics: Ending a narrow formula for understanding
captions.energy: Making meaning’s foundations accessible to both
captions.emotions: Feeling trust in a meaningful principle

meaning: Ending a narrow explanation and seeing its foundations in particular material can make a principle clearer within your shared view.
text: A principle can remain while its earlier explanation ends. Death in the physical position of Ajna ends a narrow formula for understanding. The Sun in energy makes meaning’s foundations accessible to both. The Hierophant in emotions feels trust in a meaningful principle. Your view can distinguish an important idea from a familiar form that no longer reveals it fully, allowing a rule to retain significance through an actual relationship rather than the authority of its old wording.

For example, you discuss illustrating an explanation. You previously assumed an image itself replaces all words. A complex diagram reveals a need for short captions beside transitions. **Ending a narrow formula lets a principle become clearly understandable.** Replacing text stops explaining an image’s value. You now see it showing relationships while captions name actions. Your view gains accessible foundations: different means reveal different aspects. Trust belongs to the understood meaning of visual clarity while particular material may require both an image and precise verbal explanation.

The risk is making the discovered combination compulsory for every good explanation. One clear example becomes a universal standard. Wanting meaning to be accessible preserves scale. Captions reveal transitions here while other material may be understood differently. Your view stays substantial when an ended formula does not become another rigid rule and the principle’s foundations can be examined again through a further example.
